subject: Budget range validation — monthly spend band & procurement thresholds (Apex Health)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Chen <claire@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@apexhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up & budget range validation — Redwood x Apex Health

Hi Claire / Tom,

Thanks again for the chat today — really appreciate the context on where you want to use the model (patient intake triage + clinical note summarization). Quick recap and a couple items I promised to validate on pricing: 

Key sizing we discussed:
- Active users hitting the assistant: ~12k monthly (peaks during business hours)
- Average session: 3 prompts / user, avg tokens per prompt ~1,200 (with 1.5x for assistant responses)
- Estimated token volume: ~12k * 3 * 1,200 * 1.5 = ~64.8M tokens/month (rounding to 65M)

Quick unit-econ back-of-envelope (using our standard hosted rates as a starting point):
- Baseline: $X / 1M prompt tokens + $Y / 1M response tokens (see attached pricing sheet for current tiers)
- For 65M tokens/month, target band you mentioned ($/month) was in the mid to high five-figures — want to confirm the procurement threshold you need to make this self-service for procurement (e.g., $50k/mo vs $75k/mo vs $125k/mo commit).

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm if your procurement threshold for a single vendor contract is $50k / $75k / $125k monthly? That determines if we propose a reserved capacity discount vs hosted usage.
2) Do you have any hard constraints on token accounting (e.g., do you treat tokens as input+output or only billable on output)?
3) I'll attach a quick pricing worksheet and two model-choice scenarios (higher-throughput smaller-context model vs larger-context variant that reduces round trips).

I'll loop Marissa (our pricing lead) on the next email once we have the threshold so she can propose committed bands and volume discounts.

Best,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: Redwood_pricing_v3.xlsx (price tiers), Apex_MA_plan_draft.pdf (mutual action plan template)

From: Claire Chen <claire@apexhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@apexhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & budget range validation — Redwood x Apex Health

Thanks, Dylan — good summary. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement threshold: our procurement team will allow self-service contracting up to $75k/month. Anything above that requires a two-week legal and finance review and an exec sign-off (possible but slower).
- Token accounting: we treat billable usage as input + output combined. For our budgeting model we assume 1.6x markup on prompt tokens to capture assistant output and retries.
- Model choice: we'd prefer the larger-context variant if it reduces user-visible round trips even if it costs a bit more per-token — user experience is important for clinical notes.

If you can send a committed-band proposal at $50k/mo and $75k/mo with clear unit economics ($/1M tokens) and what the auto-scaling / overage terms look like, that will help us pick which path to start procurement on.

Claire

--
Claire Chen
Head of Product Operations | Apex Health
claire@apexhealth.com | 617-555-7878

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Claire Chen <claire@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom@apexhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up & budget range validation — Redwood x Apex Health

Claire — thanks for the fast response and clear thresholds. Per your ask, attached is a short worksheet and two committed-band options. Highlights below (numbers illustrative; see attached XLSX for line-by-line):

Scenario A — $50k/month committed band:
- Unit price (combined input+output): $12 / 1M tokens
- Estimated covered tokens at $50k: ~4.167B tokens (math: $50,000 / ($12/1,000,000) = 4.167B)

Scenario B — $75k/month committed band:
- Proposed unit price (combined): $9 / 1M tokens
- $75k at $9 per 1M covers ~8.333B tokens (math: $75,000 / ($9/1,000,000) = 8.333B)

Notes / caveats:
- Those per-1M rates reflect hosted commitments with a 12-month term and standard uptime SLA. Dedicated / reserved capacity would change the unit economics (lower per-token) but require a minimum 3-6 month capacity notice + seat-based minimums.
- Overage: we propose soft overage (we bill overage at a banded rate) with auto-throttle protections to avoid bill shocks. Exact overage bands are in the XLSX.
- Procurement-friendly items: we can accept PO + standard SOW, and we have SOC2 + data processing addendum ready.

Next step: Marissa — could you review the two committed-band numbers above and suggest a recommended proposal to present to Apex? If we can tighten the per-1M numbers (especially for the 65M tokens/mo estimate Claire gave) we should highlight the total monthly cost and potential savings if they move to reserved capacity within 90 days.

Thanks — I kept the message tight to avoid confusing the procurement folks.

Best,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Redwood_pricing_v3.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Chen <claire@apexhealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & budget range validation — Redwood x Apex Health

Hi Claire, Dylan — looping in Rishi (pricing ops) and sharing recommended committed-band numbers after a quick internal check. Thanks for the detailed sizing — I focused on the 65M tokens/month baseline.

Recommendation (clean line-items):
- Option 1 (conservative): $50,000 / month (12-month term)
  - Unit price: $18 / 1M tokens (hosted, includes 30-day overage band at +25% rate)
  - Estimated covered tokens: ~2.78B tokens (math: $50,000 / ($18/1,000,000) = 2.78B)
  - Notes: this option is procurement-friendly and keeps monthly commit within your $75k self-serve threshold.

- Option 2 (preferred for volume): $75,000 / month (12-month term)
  - Unit price: $11 / 1M tokens
  - Estimated covered tokens: ~6.818B tokens
  - Notes: recommended if Apex expects growth and prefers price predictability. Enables us to offer a one-time onboarding credit and a 10% discount on model switching during the first 90 days.

If Apex confirms they want to start procurement on Option 2, we can draft a clean PO-ready quote and propose a 60-day onboarding plan. If they prefer to start with Option 1 and move to reserved capacity later, we can add auto-upgrade language into the SOW.

Claire — can you confirm which option to send to procurement? If you'd like, we can prepare a short one-page justification (savings vs pay-as-you-go) to include with the PO.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
